pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark-pigmented polygonal regions with moderate edge angularity. The pixel gradients at the boundaries show high contrast against the lighter corridors. Patch spatial area is greater on the upper torso and diminishes toward the ventral and lower neck regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A light-tan negative-space lattice with high continuity throughout the visible frame. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent (three-way intersections). The pathways maintain a relatively uniform pixel thickness, widening slightly at the base of the neck and shoulder transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane silhouette consists of a high-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth pattern along the upper neck and shoulder. The contour is formed by dense, short hair tufts creating a jagged line against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized patch of whitish textural disruption and depigmentation is visible on the upper shoulder area, appearing as a raised, scaly irregularity within the dark pelage.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor punctate textural disruptions are visible on the skin surface at the points of contact where oxpeckers are perched on the neck and dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of five Red-billed Oxpeckers (Buphagus erythrorhynchus) clustered on the dorsal ridge and lateral shoulder regions.
